summary: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that automatically removes redundant sandbox_permissions and justification fields from GPT-family tool calls before execution while preserving true permission escalations.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily an automation utility for DeepSeek Harness that automatically adjusts GPT-family tool-call arguments before execution, specifically stripping redundant sandbox permission fields to satisfy DSH strict escalation rules while keeping true escalations intact. The user-facing purpose is to reduce failed sandbox checks and simplify permission handling during tool invocation, with model matching and behavior controlled by plugin configuration.
